name: @community/rules-tests
description: Tests for the Firestore security rules, run against the Firestore emulator

scripts.test: echo 'The security rules are tested with test:rules, which needs Java' && exit 0
scripts.test:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@15.3.1 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-community --config ../community/firebase.json "pnpm --filter @community/rules-tests exec vitest run"
